name: gnns
reference: Sobolevsky, Belyi. Graph Neural Network Sampling for community detection. Applied Network Science 2022.

upstream.note: Upstream is a Jupyter notebook, not a library. gnns.py is the algorithm cells hand-extracted from it (GPL-3.0, attribution preserved in the file header); the notebook's installs, demo, and benchmarking cells are omitted. Run scripts/nbextract.py on the pinned notebook to reproduce the full source and audit the extraction. Our only change to the algorithm is a timeout argument in runGNNSSeries; training is run_gnns.py on the shared harness.

num_random_configs.doc: Number of random GNNS configurations sampled per run; the search breadth.

fraction_to_keep.doc: Fraction of configurations carried between refinement stages.

iterations_per_stage.doc: Iterations per refinement stage. Settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.
